dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and devoid of visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity consistent with a mature or near-mature phenotype.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, faint darker grey tonal variations observed primarily in the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients with no sharp edges between slight tonal variations and the primary skin color.
